profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | Android / iOS Developer | Mobile Development Manager | Mobile Applications Development
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer with multi-platform mobile development experience, who strongly focuses on clean code implementation, mobile application architecture and in-team cooperation. My main concern is to help our team deliver clear, maintainable, scalable, and testable code in an appropriate time period.

I believe that everyone worth their opportunity to impact this world and reveal all talents. My passion is to convert great opportunities into great results, which will create even greater opportunities. 

My path of 5+ years of mobile development started from opportunity as an intern in a small startup, but led me to become a multi-platform(Android/IOS) developer. This furthred me to a great opportunity to start as a full-time software developer in leading internet company in Kazakhstan(Kolesa.kz). With a given opportunity to create a team to develop 3 of the most popular mobile applications with more than 1 000 000 active users, I created the best mobile development team in our country and I was honored to become the team lead, which opened opportunity to communicate with management, web development, designers and other teams. This prospect converted an evolving development team into a department, to ensure that business growth had strong support from development team as a long term goal.
Currently I have a great opportunity to study at Vancouver and I am looking ways to convert it into a great result.

positions.title: Head of Mobile Application Development Department
positions.description:
Promoted twice since started as Software Developer. First to Team Lead Developer, then to Head of Department
Established a Mobile Development Department from scratch to 16 people (13 developers, 3 QA)
Brought Agile(Scrum) methodology to software development process, which helped separate the development of 5 products between 6 people equally
Built core software development processes: Code Review, Continuous Integration, Testing, Documentation which helped to achieve 99% crash free users in a 1M+ users app
Designed and partially developed unified SDK for 3 android projects, which helped to keep code base cleaner
Collaborated with product owners, designers, backend developers, QA teams, mobile developers and an outsource team to create 3 brand new applications: with cumulative over 1M active users
Setup and mentored four streams of internship program at the company for Android and iOS developers, 38% of interns stayed to work in the company

positions.title: Lead Android/iOS developer
positions.description:
Rewritten Kolesa.kz android app with material design:
The number of downloads doubled and now more than 1 000 000 active downloads
Application rating increased to 4.5 on Google Play Store
Designed extendable and flexible SDK to implement business logic following S.O.L.I.D principle and used design patterns like Singleton, Factory, Builder, Facade
Improved list scrolling performance to 60 fps(for most devices) by choosing a better data structure
In code review process found and prevent several huge memory leaks
Decreased application build time from 3 minutes to 10 seconds for development build, which increased development speed by using Flavor separation
Led a team of 4 developers and 1 QA engineer, and mentored their professional growth

positions.title: Mobile Application Developer
positions.description:
Was responsible for an SDK for iOS Developers to control robot blocks
Implemented connection protocol to Bluetooth peripherals

positions.title: Software Engineer (Freelance) Android / iOS
positions.description:
Developed Android and iOS client application for online ticket selling system
Supported and improved it on demand, extended functionality from only cinema tickets to various of different event types

Developed scanner application for LineaPro(ios), and Android Qr code reader, for event organizators to check online tickets from mobile devices

https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=kz.glatis.ticketon
https://itunes.apple.com/kz/app/ticketon-prodaza-biletov-onlajn/id691078668
